published_implementation.historical_relation: Benchmark-defined evidence migrated from the function-specific direct-observation registry. The neutral record preserves public protocol/result provenance without assigning canonical harness ownership.

adaptation_loop: execute current harness on validation tasks
evolver diagnoses failures and edits persistent executable harness
validation-only feedback selects later harness state
selected harness is frozen and evolver sandbox destroyed
disjoint held-out evaluation measures future capability
observations.future_evaluation: The evolver cannot access the 448-task evaluation suite during evolution; only the 160-task validation suite is available. Final evaluation occurs after the selected harness is frozen.
